children: said on Thursday that its co-founder and CEO Niklas Östberg would remain chief executive beyond March 31, 2027, contrary to the plans it had announced in May.
The decision reflects a fundamentally changed situation related to Uber's
ongoing takeover offer, Delivery Hero said.
In July, Uber agreed to buy Delivery Hero in a deal valuing the German food delivery company at an equity value of $14.8 billion to create the largest food-delivery group outside China.
